subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be controlled by a new `dmThreadMode` account key, or should the behavior be modeled through the existing `replyToMode` threading API?
rationale: Both choices are plausible, but this is a user-facing config API and message-delivery compatibility decision that automation should not settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Choose the config API first
options.body: Before merge, decide the permanent API shape, then require the branch to align runtime, types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and proof with that shape.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a separate knob
options.body: This preserves the contributor's proposed direction, but the PR still needs the full config contract and live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Fold the behavior into `replyToMode`
options.body: This avoids a second threading setting but likely needs a narrower replacement patch or a revision to this branch.

recommendation.title: Choose the config API first
recommendation.body: Before merge, decide the permanent API shape, then require the branch to align runtime, types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and proof with that shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This person committed the prior DM thread-send suppression and landed earlier Google Chat thread reply support, making them the best available owner for the threading API decision.
